name: just-blame-cloudflare
description: Serve a simulated Cloudflare outage page during maintenance, with Browser and Host marked Working and Cloudflare marked Error. Uses the original error-page layout and icons, automatically displays the current hostname, and estimates the nearest Cloudflare city from a bundled IPv4/IPv6 GeoIP database. Works without Cloudflare, API keys, or external runtime lookups. No persistent storage or domain configuration needed.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Plain HTTP port for previewing the outage page or connecting your reverse proxy. HTTPS is handled by your own proxy.

variables.name: Trust Reverse Proxy
variables.description: Enable for visitor GeoIP behind your proxy, only when clients cannot bypass it. Your proxy must overwrite X-Real-IP with the visitor IP; otherwise the rightmost X-Forwarded-For entry is used. With multiple proxies, configure trusted real-IP handling at your proxy. Does not change HTTPS or hostname detection.

variables.name: Fallback Location Code
variables.description: Optional Cloudflare code for private, LAN, or unknown IPs, such as IAD (Ashburn) or LHR (London). Blank displays Cloudflare network. Successful GeoIP estimates always take priority.
